Our team recommends a consistent approach to keep your plantation shutters looking their best. Following a few easy steps will help preserve their appearance and operation.

Regular Cleaning

  • Dust Regularly: Use a soft, clean cloth, a feather duster, or a vacuum cleaner with a brush attachment to gently remove dust. This prevents buildup that can be harder to clean later.
  • Spot Clean as Needed: For minor marks or smudges, lightly dampen a soft cloth with water and a mild soap solution. Wipe the affected area carefully, then dry immediately with a clean, dry cloth to prevent water spots.

Maintenance Tips
